issue: loop objective (stability penalty and tuning to MCD12Q2) would have pulled each year toward the average and copied MCD12Q2's trend
consequence: loop redesigned to score synthetic recovery only and kept off inference

issue: validation planned against MCD12Q2 Greenup (15%) for a 50% metric
consequence: compared against MidGreenup instead

issue: snow-off predictor would share the MODIS snow signal used to build NDVI
consequence: predictors taken from ERA5-Land and the station

issue: MOD10A1 NDSI misread as fractional snow cover
consequence: threshold reinterpreted as NDSI

issue: area mean over cloud-free pixels changes composition daily
consequence: fixed per-pixel stratified sample

issue: loop guards relied on the agent's honesty
consequence: enforcement moved into a driver outside the agent

issue: synthetic generator could be matched by its own curve shape
consequence: mixed curve families and a held-out real-shape family

issue: WDPA boundary licence restricts redistribution
consequence: Parks Canada boundary under Open Government Licence

issue: driver parsed changed-file paths incorrectly (src/ became rc/)
consequence: parsing fixed and tested with scripted rule-breaking agents

issue: park boundary reprojected with the wrong UTM zone (longitude -105 instead of -93)
consequence: reprojected from the shipped projection file

issue: percentile baseline attributed to Beck et al. (2006)
consequence: re-attributed to the MCD12Q2 dormant-value rule

issue: Doiron et al. (2013) define green-up as 50% of the annual maximum on AVHRR
consequence: definition justified with data (undefined in 92% of pixels)

issue: MCD12Q2 definitions came from a non-peer-reviewed user guide and use EVI2
consequence: peer-reviewed assessment added and comparison described as analogous

issue: a homogenized Churchill temperature series exists
consequence: station splice validated against it (r = 0.9995)

issue: trend-free pre-whitening can inflate Type I error
consequence: three further Mann-Kendall variants reported

issue: power analysis conventionally uses the series' own residuals
consequence: own-series minimum detectable trend reported

issue: commonality shares reported as shares of explained variance
consequence: corrected (shared component is 43% of explained variance)

issue: causal language contradicted the pre-registered reading
consequence: rewritten as associations

issue: conflict with Mallory et al. (2020) held only for the primary specification and a mismatched window
consequence: matched 2004-2016 comparison showed the results are compatible

issue: station snow-off check reused ERA5-Land in 9 of 24 years
consequence: station-only check reported (R² = 0.27)

issue: MCD12Q2 annual r computed differently from the description
consequence: description corrected

issue: Kouki et al. (2023) cited for a claim it does not make
consequence: citation corrected

issue: post-melt snow flags treated as dormancy (iteration 8)
consequence: improved held-out error and annual agreement but not adopted under the entry rule

issue: framing and prose did not match the author's register
consequence: rewritten
